name: Samyang Holdings Corporation
summary: Samyang Holdings Corporation, together its subsidiaries, engages in chemical, food, packaging, and other businesses in South Korea, China, Japan, Other Asian countries, Europe, and internationally. The company operates through three segments: Food, Chemicals, and Others. It produces and sells engineering plastics, ion exchange resins, BPA chemicals, personal care materials, eco-friendly materials, semiconductor materials, and other chemical materials.
